citations.cites: E-16 – Water backup exclusion overridden by HO-0820

facts: Municipal sewer surcharged in a storm and backed up through the floor drain into the finished basement.
note: The loss is a water‑backup event through a municipal sewer drain into the finished basement, which matches the definition of “water backup” in HO‑0820 (HO-0820_05-24#02). Because endorsement HO‑0820 is attached, it overrides exclusion E‑16 in HO‑0304 (HO-0304_03-24#05) and provides coverage up to the $10,000 per‑event sub‑limit with a $1,000 deductible (HO-0820_05-24#03).
